name: feai
description: Web-based CAD Software with REST API

scripts.dev: npm run build:frontend && npm run dev:server

scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w @feai/shared && npm run build -w @feai/kernel && npm run build -w @feai/frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:generate && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:server
